_comment: Swerling variant of scenario_missed_detections.json (target realism report, Part I). IDENTICAL to the published tracker-report baseline (section 3.1.1: Pd 0.61, 1 track ID, CLEAN at the canonical seed) except for the added fluctuation block. Swerling factors are unit-mean-POWER, so the mean SNR is unchanged -- every difference from the published numbers is attributable to fading alone. frame_corr 0.9 (voltage corr; power corr 0.81; fade decorrelation time ~4.7 frames). This file exists for the single-run CLI illustration only; the sweep (tracker_stress_swerling_sweep.py) instead loads scenario_missed_detections.json directly and injects fading per grid cell.
